# SOPscape Council

SOPscape Council is an agent-native service that turns standard operating procedures into traceable AI decision rehearsals.

## Public service

- Product: https://sopscape-production.up.railway.app/
- Public A2MCP endpoint: POST /a2mcp/generate-rehearsal
- The service returns expert consensus, disagreements, evidence gaps, recommended paths, decision nodes, and a digital passport.
- Do not submit secrets, credentials, or personal data in SOP content.
